channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Education Accolades
item.description: Area students from Austin, Hayfield and nearby towns earn Fall 2025 dean’s list, honors list and degrees from Minnesota, Wisconsin and South Dakota colleges.

item.title: Cougars outrun Athletics in Pacelli Gym
item.description: Lyle-Pacelli’s late rally and 19-point nights from Casimir Assogba and Hunter Wollenberg weren’t enough as the Cougars held on for an 87-79 win at Pacelli Gym.

item.title: Walker scores 31 as Viking down NRHEG
item.description: Charlie Walker scores 31 points with five threes as Hayfield routs New Richland-HEG 86-47, improving the Vikings to 13-8 on the season.

item.title: Packer boys struggle with their shot in loss to Huskies
item.description: Austin boys go cold in 78-55 loss at Owatonna, dropping to 11-7 overall as Bayaan Omot leads the Packers with 13 points.

item.title: Staloch nets 29 as BP downs Spring Grove
item.description: Gabe Staloch pours in 29 as Blooming Prairie edges Spring Grove 57-53, improving to 16-6 overall.

item.title: WEM comes back to beat Blooming Prairie girls
item.description: Blooming Prairie girls fall 71-62 at WEM after leading 62-60 with 2:30 left, going scoreless the rest of the way despite 15 points from Claire Schwarz and 14 from Ellie Stoen.

item.title: Huskies bring down Austin girls basketball team
item.description: Owatonna girls basketball overwhelms Austin 71-27 at Ove Berven Gym, dropping the Packers to 4-17 after trailing 39-9 at halftime.

item.title: NRHEG's Vanmaldeghem proves too much for Viking girls
item.description: Vanmaldeghem scores 39 and surpasses 2,000 career points as No. 3 NRHEG edges Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy 56-53; Christopherson leads Vikings with 21 in comeback bid.

item.title: Southland girls overpower Kenyon-Wanamingo
item.description: Grace Kresbach scores 18 as Southland (18-3) overpowers Kenyon-Wanamingo (8-15) 62-28 in Kenyon in girls basketball.

item.title: Bruins top Norsemen, will host Paint the Rink Pink game Saturday night
item.description: Cody Butikis’ 16 saves and Siamion Marshchanok’s 23rd goal lifted the Austin Bruins over St. Cloud 3-1; they meet again Saturday for Paint the Rink Pink at Riverside Arena.
